title: Theme change as a full-screen shader wipe with a noise edge
summary: A fixed, click-through orthographic quad (`ShaderMaterial`, `#include <colorspace_fragment>`, premultiplied alpha, DPR ≤ 2) grows the next theme's ground from the press point (`uCenter`; a key press starts at the button's centre) as `uProgress` runs `0 → 1` over `.9 s power2.inOut`, its rim moved by two octaves of hash value noise (`uEdge 56 px`) with exact ends (radius `−edge … farthest corner + edge`); `data-theme` flips only on the tween's completion under full cover, then the cover fades `.3 s` and is hidden; a second press mid-cover reverses the same edge; the choice kept in `sessionStorage` and restored by a head script before first paint; an `aria-pressed` button; the shader compiled ahead at idle; a CSS `circle()` cover on the same driver without WebGL; an instant swap with no canvas frame under reduced motion
variants: two grounds behind an aria-pressed toggle, sessionStorage for the visit (this, default)
several named grounds: one button per ground with aria-pressed, the same cover in that ground's colour
route change: the same cover grown from the clicked link, the route swapped under full cover
no WebGL: the same proxy drives a CSS clip-path circle (?gl=0)
